en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with three photographs. The top view shows a tree‑lined spa promenade with modernist buildings, benches, and people walking, captioned in German. The center view is a panoramic landscape of a wooded valley town with a church tower and river, with the town name written in stylized script. The bottom view shows a spa square with colonnades, fountains or springs, people strolling and sitting, again captioned in German. The overall style is classic central‑European spa‑town imagery.
